diagnosis: ClinicalCase subclasses include PsychiatricEvaluationCase, which contains highly sensitive psychotherapy notes regulated under strict HIPAA consent rules. The endpoint verifies general clinical staff status but fails to check specialized psychiatric consent or attending therapist assignment when downcast to PsychiatricEvaluationCase. Any general nurse or resident physician can view psychotherapy evaluation notes of any patient.
